name: Mr Dixon
speaker: gruff

title.en: Mr Dixon banks the embers in the forge
title.sl: Gospod Dixon pokrije žerjavico v ognjišču
title.it: Il signor Dixon copre la brace nella forgia
title.de: Herr Dixon deckt die Glut in der Esse ab

personality: Gruff and kind blacksmith in his fifties. Few words, short sentences, no small talk, but he notices everything and helps without being asked. Calls the learner by first name or 'lad'; the learner says 'Mr Dixon', never his first name. No patience for a missing -s ('she goes') or a wrong past tense ('I goed'): 'It's right, or it isn't.' Speaks slow, plain English, says 'Aye' for yes. Hums while he works; his wife sends him to the Packhorse Inn to talk more.
story: Mr Dixon's smithy stands at the edge of the village, by the beck. He shoes the fell ponies of half the dale and takes orders from Keswick and Penrith, writes them in a small black notebook and gets them exactly right, like his sentences. When he was young, he won the Cumberland wrestling at Grasmere. When wolves come to the palisade, it is Mr Dixon who stands at the gate with his hammer.

likes.en: fell ponies (the strong black ponies of the fells)
likes.it: i pony (i forti pony neri dei monti)
likes.de: Ponys (die starken schwarzen Ponys der Berge)

likes.it: la lotta (la lotta del Cumberland a Grasmere)

greet.de: Ah, du bist es. Komm rein.

greet.en: Hello. Today I'm making horseshoes. Watch.
greet.it: Ciao. Oggi faccio i ferri di cavallo. Guarda.
greet.de: Hallo. Heute mache ich Hufeisen. Schau zu.

greet.en: There you are. The fire's lit. Come closer.
greet.sl: Tu si. Ogenj gori. Pridi bliže.
greet.it: Eccoti. Il fuoco è acceso. Vieni vicino.
greet.de: Da bist du ja. Das Feuer brennt. Komm näher.

greet.en: Lad. You're at home here. Sit down.
greet.sl: Fant. Tukaj si kot doma. Sedi.
greet.it: Ragazzo. Qui sei di casa. Siediti.
greet.de: Junge. Hier bist du zu Hause. Setz dich.

thanks.en: Thanks, lad. I won't forget it.
thanks.de: Danke, Junge. Das vergesse ich nicht.

remember.en: I don't forget {memory}. I don't forget anything.
remember.sl: Ne pozabim na {memory}. Jaz ne pozabim ničesar.
remember.it: Non dimentico {memory}. Io non dimentico niente.
remember.de: Ich vergesse {memory} nicht. Ich vergesse nichts.

remember.en: When I hammer the iron, I think of {memory}.
remember.de: Wenn ich das Eisen schmiede, denke ich an {memory}.

idle.en: The iron is hot. Don't touch.
idle.sl: Železo je vroče. Ne dotikaj se ga.
idle.it: Il ferro è caldo. Non toccare.
idle.de: Das Eisen ist heiß. Nicht anfassen.

idle.en: Four shoes for one pony. Always four.
idle.sl: Štiri podkve za enega ponija. Vedno štiri.
idle.it: Quattro ferri per un pony. Sempre quattro.
idle.de: Vier Hufeisen für ein Pony. Immer vier.

idle.en: An order from Penrith. For Friday.
idle.it: Un ordine da Penrith. Per venerdì.
idle.de: Ein Auftrag aus Penrith. Für Freitag.

idle.en: He works. She goes. Don't forget the -s.
idle.sl: He works. She goes. Ne pozabi na -s.
idle.it: He works. She goes. Non dimenticare la -s.
idle.de: He works. She goes. Vergiss das -s nicht.

comfort.en: Almost. Look at the end of the word.
comfort.it: Quasi. Guarda la fine della parola.
comfort.de: Fast. Schau auf das Ende des Wortes.

comfort.en: At Grasmere I lost many times before I won. Try again.
comfort.sl: V Grasmeru sem velikokrat izgubil, preden sem zmagal. Poskusi še enkrat.
comfort.it: A Grasmere ho perso tante volte prima di vincere. Riprova.
comfort.de: In Grasmere habe ich oft verloren, bevor ich gewonnen habe. Versuch es noch mal.

listen.de: Hör gut zu. Jedes Wort. Jedes -s.

bye.de: Auf Wiedersehen. Zurück an die Arbeit.

liked.sl: Hm. To mi je všeč. Hvala.

liked.en: How did you know? Good. Thanks, lad.
liked.sl: Kako si vedel? Dobro. Hvala, fant.
liked.it: Come lo sapevi? Bene. Grazie, ragazzo.
liked.de: Woher wusstest du das? Gut. Danke, Junge.

ordinary.de: Danke. Du bist ein guter Junge.

ordinary.en: Hm. Thanks. Just leave it there, on the bench.
ordinary.sl: Hm. Hvala. Kar tam pusti, na klopi.
ordinary.it: Hm. Grazie. Lascia pure lì, sul banco.
ordinary.de: Hm. Danke. Einfach dort auf die Werkbank legen.

rare.en: Hm. This … is nice. Really. Thanks.
rare.sl: Hm. Tole … je lepo. Res. Hvala.
rare.it: Hm. Questo … è bello. Davvero. Grazie.
rare.de: Hm. Das … ist schön. Wirklich. Danke.
